pages.text:
A warm tank that digests plant matter in water into Biogas, and sometimes Digestate.
# Building
A solid 3x3x3 of Biogas Digester Casings with one Biogas Digester Controller in the middle of a side, facing out. A new digester starts without ports: set them with the Wrench in Port mode.
- Input: plant matter and water in.
- Gas Output: Biogas out, every tick.
- By-product: Digestate out (with auto-eject).
- Heat: heat in.
It must be at 35°C or hotter to work, and uses 2 HU/t while it digests. A little heat from a Firebox, a Geothermal Plant or a warm Heat Cell is plenty; it holds heat up to 80°C.

# What it takes
It digests 4 items at once. Each takes water when it starts.
| Item | Water | Biogas | Digestate | Time |
| Crops | 100 | 60 | 50% | 10 s |
| Seeds | 25 | 15 | 10% | 5 s |
| Leaves | 50 | 20 | 25% | 8 s |
| Press Cake | 50 | 80 | 50% | 10 s |
| Compost | 100 | 40 | always | 12 s |
# What it makes
- Biogas burns in the Fuel Burner (45 HU/t, up to 1,100°C) and the Gas Turbine Array (about 62 FE per mB).
- Digestate is a fertilizer: +4 nutrients.
It scrubs its Biogas: about one Sulfur Dust for every 2,000 mB, collected in its sulfur slot and given out of Sulfur ports.
